evidence: The Ni/A1203 catalysts were prepared by growing oxidized nickel species on alumina by sequential reactions with vaporized Ni(acac)2 and air. The preheating was carried out in a muffle furnace under atmospheric pressure at 200-950~ for 6-16 h and, in addition, in the ALE reactor at 200-450~ for 3 h to remove water adsorbed during the transfer. The solid Ni(acac)2 reactant was vaporized at 200~ The temperature and length of the Ni(acac)2 sequence was 200~ and 3-4 h, respectively. The air sequence was initiated at 200~ and continued at 400~ for a total of 4-5 h to remove the ligand residues from the samples. Each reaction sequence was completed with a nitrogen purge at the reaction temperature
